name: std::basic_spanbuf<CharT,Traits>::seekpos

declarations.code:
protected:
pos_type seekpos(pos_type sp,
    std::ios_base::openmode which =

        std::ios_base::in | std::ios_base::out) override;

intro:
Repositions the next pointer to the get and/or put area, if possible, to the position indicated by sp.

Equivalent to return seekoff(off_type(sp), std::ios_base::beg, which);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
sp

 -

  stream position, such as one obtained by seekoff() or seekpos()


  which

 -

  defines whether the input sequences, the output sequence, or both are affected. It can be one or a combination of the following constants:



  Constant

  Explanation




  in

  affect the input sequence




  out

  affect the output sequence

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: sp on success or pos_type(off_type(-1)) on failure.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: seekpos() is called by std::basic_streambuf::pubseekpos(), which is called by the single-argument versions of std::basic_istream::seekg() and std::basic_ostream::seekp().
